characteristic_signatures.vacuum_leak: Misfire rate rises with load alongside elevated positive fuel trims (>+10%); random distribution across cylinders.
characteristic_signatures.ignition_fault: Misfires concentrated on specific cylinders with normal fuel trims.
characteristic_signatures.weak_fuel_delivery: Misfires at high load/high demand with negative-going trims or low fuel pressure.
characteristic_signatures.compression_mechanical: Misfire persists at all conditions, often single-cylinder; compression test abnormal.
